player_character.skeleton_relationship: Robot and vehicle are separate skeletons with no shared bone names (106 vs 69 joints). Transformation = robot clip Transform_ToVehicle_ROBO / vehicle clip Transform_ToVehicle_VEH (and the reverse Transform_ToRobot_*), each on its own skeleton; the game swaps meshes during the transition.
